Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Year in Review 2022 - Episode 532 of the Community Broadband Bits Podcast By Ry Marcattilio on Dec 19, 2022 It's December, which means it's time to pull the staff together and get a handle on what happened in the broadband landscape in 2022. Joining Christopher is GIS and Data Visualization Specialist Christine Parker, Associate Researcher Emma Gautier, Outreach Team Lead DeAnne Cuellar, Senior Reporter and Communications Team Lead Sean Gonsalves, and Senior Researcher and Research Team Lead Ry Marcattilio. Fitting all of those titles into one recording studio was a real project, but it led to a constructive conversation about preemption laws, the broadband nutrition label, BEAD funding and the new Broadband Data Collection (BDC) process, the supply chain, and more. There were a couple of surprises in 2022, and the staff reckons with how their predictions from last year held up in the face of things. This show is 53 minutes long and can be played on this page or via Apple Podcasts or the tool of your choice using this feed . Transcript below.
